methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The paper gives a chronological overview of the development of energy management standards and explains the standard implementation.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Chronological overview of the development of energy management standards (history of national standards and the ISO 50001 family; worldwide and Croatia certification statistics). EnPI/EnB appear only incidentally at the generic ISO 50006 concept level (EnPI as kWh/unit relative to an energy baseline, in a figure reproduced from a cited source). No specific EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised: no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach is identifiable.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The paper gives a chronological overview of the development of energy management standards and explains the standard implementation.

stage1.notes: Standards-development overview; EnPI/EnB mentioned only as generic ISO 50006 concepts (kWh/unit vs baseline, from a cited source). No model characterised -> ineligible; level_3b not applicable.
